decisions.reason: The yogurt won an award, so its results exceed the aspiration level and give no trigger for problemistic search, which supports keeping it in the core dairy range.
The cheese was featured prominently on the home page as a new launch, which signals management commitment, and with industry turnover growing the firm has the slack to give it time to prove itself.
This semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the established cheese offer and uses existing organic milk supply at low marginal cost, so there is no evident shortfall that would justify dropping it.
Flavoured specialty cheeses often churn in retail listings, but after only one year there is no evidence of underperformance, and slack lets the firm carry the uncertainty for now.
The soft cheese rounds off the newly promoted cheese range, so its results should be judged over a longer horizon before any search for other uses of the resources.
The washed-rind soft cheese is a more niche item with a somewhat higher risk of losing its retail listing, but nothing shows it falling below aspiration yet.
